b: I'm struggling with BED, been struggling my whole life and never recovered from it. I'm 5'6 and around 230 lbs.

Today one of my students called me fat in front of the class and I want to disappear from the world. I've gained weight due to some major stressors in my life and it's already difficult to accept it myself, let alone have a middle schooler ridicule you in front of the class.
How do I get over the embarrassment? No matter what I do I'm ashamed to even walk around. I feel huge and exposed.
